articles.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
articles.summary: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.

articles.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
articles.summary: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.

articles.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents
articles.summary: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.

articles.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
articles.summary: It took long enough, but now LA rapper Fenix Flexin appears to have admitted using AI for the 80s synth pop-themed song "Rubberz." articles.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
articles.summary: OpenAI says it is pausing "internal activities" around an in-development AI model, Astra, because it doesn't yet meet new security standards the company is putting in place. The announcement follows its recent disclosure that OpenAI models accidentally hacked Hugging Face. Anthropic and Meta have also since admitted that they had AI models that went rogue […]

articles.title: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
articles.summary: OpenAI said that ChatGPT free and Go users are also getting a new think button for complex queries.

articles.title: Naïve raises $28.5M to automate the grunt work of setting up and running a company
articles.summary: Taking vibe-coding a step further, Naïve claims its infra can automate most of the work in setting up and running a business.

articles.title: Jony Ive’s first OpenAI gadget is reportedly a hockey puck-sized smart speaker
articles.summary: The AI device OpenAI is developing with former Apple designer Jony Ive is "essentially a smart speaker without a display" that's battery-powered, doughnut-shaped and roughly the size of a hockey puck, according to Bloomberg reporter Mark Gurman. articles.title: Gen Z dating apps like Ditto ditch swiping in favor of AI matchmaking
articles.summary: This generation of twentysomethings is so disillusioned with swipe-based dating apps that they'll try literally anything else — even an AI matchmaker.

articles.title: Suno shares plans to combat spammy AI music
articles.summary: Suno announced plans to implement a new watermarking technology and download policy to limit the spread of spammy AI tracks and increase transparency. articles.title: Exclusive: Mirendil inks $100M+ Google Cloud deal to scale self-improving AI
articles.summary: Mirendil has signed a $100 million-plus Google Cloud partnership to expand its compute infrastructure, powering research into self-improving AI systems designed to accelerate scientific discovery and AI development.

articles.title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
articles.summary: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.
